title: Editor Crash when creating and moving folders
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- v4.4.dev.gh [533c616cb]

### System information

Windows 10.0.22631 - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Creating new sub-folders causes the sub-folder to appear under an mysterious additional `res://` folder until the FileSystem is reloaded.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70621159-57c5-4fb6-80d7-f17f81f624a3)

Moving the new sub-folder as follows, before the FileSystem is reloaded, causes a crash:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/436a71dd-a028-4e2c-8418-59c31c783fd9)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Create a new folder named `a` in `res://`
3. Create a new folder named `b` in `a`
4. Notice that `b` appears as `res://a/res://b`
5. Move `b` into `res://`
6. Crash
